assumptions.choice: Do not set broker cash in the strategy.

assumptions.choice: Restrict signals to calendar years 2000 through 2012 inclusive.
assumptions.reason: This is the literal specified test period; the supplied 2020-2025 feed has no overlapping bars, so it produces no trades.

assumptions.choice: Enable cheat-on-close and use market orders.
assumptions.reason: This models signal-triggered trades at the current day's closing price using Backtrader's available execution mechanism.
